items.title: Larry Gold interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 18, 2025
items.q: we tried to teach Caliph how to do all that and he was real happy being here

ctx.x: Well you had no issues being accepted into that if it was a circle, but I'll call it a circle?

You know I got to, as the years went on I got more and more accepted into it. You know Kenny Gamble, I've seen him like recently and he said "Boy I wish I would have known how talented you were when we were kids." Because he thought I was just a cello player in one way. But then as the years went on he saw, and then he used to come to my studio, you know, and in one way, and then when you know his son — his son came and worked for me for a little while. Kenny called me up and said he didn't have a studio and he…

you know what? I was a shy person in a way. You know I didn't want to — I did open my mouth too much. I have to say, I wasn't that shy. But I didn't want to overstep my bounds in my relationship with Gamble, Huff and Bell.
